# @scriba-editor/plugin-math

Math formulas for the Scriba editor: the document keeps the **LaTeX** source, the HTML contains
**MathML** generated by KaTeX (every browser displays it, without scripts). A standard,
script-free output, instead of images or free-form HTML.

```bash
pnpm add @scriba-editor/plugin-math
```

KaTeX is a dependency of **this plugin only** (the rest of the editor does not use it): you
import it and pass it to `createMathNodes` (KaTeX 0.16 or later is required), so you can also
load it only when needed (`await import('katex')`).

## Usage

```ts
import katex from 'katex'
import { EditorState, Schema, keymap, basicSchemaSpec } from '@scriba-editor/core'
import { createTranslator } from '@scriba-editor/i18n'
import { EditorView } from '@scriba-editor/view'
import {
  createMathNodes,
  mathKeymap,
  mathNodeView,
  mathPlugins,
  mathSlashItem,
  mathToolbarItem,
} from '@scriba-editor/plugin-math'

const schema = new Schema({
  nodes: { ...basicSchemaSpec.nodes, ...createMathNodes(katex) },
  marks: basicSchemaSpec.marks,
})

const t = createTranslator('it')
const state = EditorState.create({
  schema,
  plugins: [keymap(mathKeymap(t), { priority: 70 }), ...mathPlugins(t)],
})
// the view: how formulas look in the editor
const view = new EditorView(document.querySelector('#editor')!, {
  state,
  nodeViews: { math_inline: mathNodeView(t), math_display: mathNodeView(t) },
})

// Insert menu and slash menu ("/formula")
const item = mathToolbarItem(t)
const slash = mathSlashItem(t)
```

## Nodes

| Node           | Where                   | Notes                        |
| -------------- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `math_inline`  | inside the text         | atom; plain text `$latex$`   |
| `math_display` | on its own line (block) | atom; plain text `$$latex$$` |

`latex` attribute (at most `MAX_LATEX` = 4000 characters, with no control characters except
line feed and tab).

## Exports

| Name                                                    | What it does                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `createMathNodes(katex)`                                | The specs of the two nodes, with the KaTeX you pass.                   |
| `mathNodeView(t)`                                       | Node view: MathML in a box with `role="math"` and `aria-label`.        |
| `openMathDialog(view, t)`                               | Dialog: LaTeX source, "On its own line", live preview.                 |
| `insertMath(latex, display)`                            | Command: inserts a formula or changes the selected one (its type too). |
| `selectedMath(state)`                                   | The selected formula, if any.                                          |
| `mathKeymap(t)`                                         | Enter on a selected formula edits it.                                  |
| `mathPlugins(t)`                                        | Double-clicking a formula edits it.                                    |
| `mathToolbarItem(t)`, `mathSlashItem(t)`                | "Formula" item in the menu and in the slash menu (not in code blocks). |
| `renderMathML`, `mathmlSpec`, `hasMath`, `MathRenderer` | Low-level tools.                                                       |

## Security

- The document stores **only LaTeX**. The MathML is **generated by the editor** (not copied):
  when reading HTML only the `application/x-tex` annotation is taken, and incoming MathML is
  thrown away and regenerated. Malicious pasted MathML does not survive.
- KaTeX always runs with the same restrictive options: `trust: false` (no `\href`, `\url`,
  `\includegraphics`, `\htmlClass`…), `maxExpand` and `maxSize` limited against macro bombs,
  MathML-only output. The MathML tree is converted into nodes by the editor, not from an HTML
  string.
- A formula that is too complex or has an error falls back to an empty MathML with the readable
  source in the annotation.
- The rendering of each formula is cached (at most 500 entries).

Saved HTML must go through `@scriba-editor/sanitize-server`: see
[security](../../../docs/security.md).

## Accessibility

Every formula has `role="math"` and a label with its LaTeX; the dialog has a focus trap, focus
return, a preview in an `aria-live` region and an announced error (`role="alert"`). Keyboard
editing with Enter. See [accessibility](../../../docs/accessibility.md) and
[plugins](../../../docs/plugins.md).
